name: CallElimCorrect.substOldPostSubset
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem substOldPostSubset:
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression)
    (substOld h2 (Lambda.LExpr.fvar m h1 ty) post)).Subset
    (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars (P:=Expression) post ++ [h1]) := by
  have o2 : ∀ {A B a b S : List Expression.Ident}, A ⊆ a ++ S → B ⊆ b ++ S → A ++ B ⊆ a ++ b ++ S := by grind
  unfold Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars
  induction post with
  | const _ _ | op _ _ _ | bvar _ _ | fvar _ _ _ => exact List.subset_append_left _ _
  | abs _ _ _ ih => assumption
  | ite _ c t f ic it iff => exact o2 (o2 ic it) iff
  | quant _ _ _ tr e iq ie => exact o2 iq ie
  | eq _ e₁ e₂ i₁ i₂ => exact o2 i₁ i₂
  | app _ fn arg ifn ia =>
      unfold substOld
      split
      · split
        · exact List.subset_append_right _ _
        · assumption
      · exact o2 ifn ia

name: CallElimCorrect.extractedOldExprInVars
proof:
open OldExpressions in
theorem extractedOldExprInVars :
  NormalizedOldExpr post →
  (extractOldExprVars post).Subset
  (Imperative.HasVarsPure.getVars post) := by
  intro H
  have h : ∀ {a b c d : List Expression.Ident}, a ⊆ c → b ⊆ d → a ++ b ⊆ c ++ d :=
    fun ac bd => List.append_subset.2
      ⟨List.subset_append_of_subset_left _ ac, List.subset_append_of_subset_right _ bd⟩
  induction H with
  | app _ _ c =>
      unfold extractOldExprVars
      split
      · exact fun _ x => x
      · next H => exfalso; cases c IsOldPred.oldPred; exact H _ _ _ rfl
      · apply h <;> assumption
  | _ => repeat (first | assumption | apply h | exact List.nil_subset _)

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' :=
  fun u i => ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit (InitStatesLength i) (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined i) u) $ InitStatesNodup i, by
    simp only [InitStatesUpdated i, UpdateStatesUpdated u]
    unfold updatedStates
    rw [updatedStatesComm]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate (UpdateStatesLength u) $ updatedStatesDefMonotone $ UpdateStatesDefined' u
    simp only [List.unzip_zip $ UpdateStatesLength u, List.unzip_zip $ InitStatesLength i]
    exact fun _ a b => absurd (UpdateStatesDefined u _ a) $ InitStatesNotDefined i _ b ▸ Bool.false_ne_true⟩

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x₀
  by_contra hx0
  let w : Y → ℝ := fun x => ⟪f x, f x₀⟫_ℝ
  have hu : Continuous w := by fun_prop
  have h₀ : 0 < w x₀ :=
    lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx0)
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ0, hδ⟩ :=
    Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (continuousAt_const.eventually_lt hu.continuousAt h₀)
  let B : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ0, half_lt_self hδ0⟩
  have key := hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨B.contDiff, B.hasCompactSupport⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x₀)))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ B x * w x := fun x => by
    rcases lt_or_ge (dist x x₀) δ with h | h
    · exact mul_nonneg B.nonneg (hδ h).le
    · rw [B.zero_of_le_dist h, zero_mul]
  exact ((B.continuous.mul hu).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero (x := x₀)
    B.hasCompactSupport.mul_right hn (mul_pos (B.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hδ0)) h₀).ne').ne' key

name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA2 : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hμ : 1 / (𝓕.μ₀ * 𝓕.ε₀) = 𝓕.c ^ 2 := by rw [mul_comm, FreeSpace.c_sq]
  have hε : 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ := by
    rw [div_eq_iff 𝓕.ε₀_ne_zero, FreeSpace.c_sq, mul_assoc, mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀,
      div_mul_cancel₀ 1 (mul_ne_zero 𝓕.ε₀_ne_zero 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero)]
  have hEs : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (fun y => A.electricField 𝓕.c t y j) :=
    fun j => (electricField_apply_contDiff_space (i := j) hA t).of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEd : ∀ j k, Differentiable ℝ (∂[k] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) :=
    fun j k => Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hBm : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 ↿(fun s y => A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s y (j, i)) :=
    fun j => (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hA (j, i)).of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hBt : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j) (hBm j) x
  have hK : Differentiable ℝ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) :=
    LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
      (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) x i
  have h1 : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) = fun s =>
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hA2 x) s,
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h, hμ, hε]
  have h2 : ∂ₜ (fun s => 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) t
      = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∂ₜ (fun s => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (fun s => J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i) t := by
    have hG : DifferentiableAt ℝ (fun s => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t :=
      (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hBt j).differentiableAt
    rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hG.const_mul _) (hK.differentiableAt.const_mul _),
      fderiv_const_mul hG, fderiv_const_mul hK.differentiableAt]
    rfl
  have h3 : ∂ₜ (fun s => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t
      = ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun y => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · y (j, i)) t) x := by
    rw [Time.deriv_fun_sum Finset.univ (fun j s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x)
      (fun j _ => (hBt j).differentiableAt)]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (hBm j) t x
  have hg : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y)
      = 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ • fun y => J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y := by
    funext y
    show (∇ ⬝ A.electricField 𝓕.c t) y = 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y
    rw [(isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y |>.1, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm]
  have hdiv : ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x
      = ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x := by
    conv_rhs => rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
    rw [fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt)]
    simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply, ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis]
  have hρ : ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
      = 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    rw [hg, Space.deriv_const_smul 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space (hJ.differentiable (by decide)) t),
      Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul]
  have h4 : ∑ j, ∂[j] (fun y => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · y (j, i)) t) x
      = ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x - 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    rw [← hρ, ← hdiv, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
    rw [show (fun y => ∂ₜ (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c · y (j, i)) t)
        = ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) - ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)
        from funext fun y => time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hA2 t y j i,
      Space.deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) (hEd j i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hEs j), Pi.sub_apply]
  rw [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv]
  ring

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let e := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  let pb (x : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) : Prop := ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * e * x) = ι (e * 𝓣ᶠ(a * x))
  refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ => pb x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis b)
  · rintro x ⟨φs, rfl⟩
    simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
    let pa (x : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) : Prop :=
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(x * e * ofCrAnListF φs) = ι (e * 𝓣ᶠ(x * ofCrAnListF φs))
    refine Submodule.span_induction (p := fun x _ => pa x) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_ (Basis.mem_span ofCrAnListFBasis a)
    · rintro x ⟨φs', rfl⟩
      simp only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList, map_mul, pa, e]
      calc _
        /- Split the commutator. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
            crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs) •
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs))) := by
          conv_lhs =>
            rw [← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              superCommuteF_ofCrAnListF_ofCrAnListF]
            simp [mul_sub, sub_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append]
            rw [timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
          simp only [map_smul, sub_right_inj]
          module
        /- Simplify the signs. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
            ι (ofCrAnListF (crAnTimeOrderList (φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs)))) := by
          rw [crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ]
          module
        /- Splitting the time-ordered lists. -/
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
          (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) -
          𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                      (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ]) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c =>
                (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF
              (List.filter (fun c => decide (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
          have h1 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [φ, ψ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs = φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs by simp, h1]
          have h2 := insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' [ψ, φ] φs
            (by simp_all)
          rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show φs' ++ ψ :: φ :: φs = φs' ++ [ψ, φ] ++ φs by norm_num, h2]
          repeat rw [ofCrAnListF_append]
          simp only [ map_mul,
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              (ι (ofCrAnListF [φ, ψ]) - 𝓢(𝓕.crAnStatistics φ, 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ) •
                ι (ofCrAnListF [ψ, φ])) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
            simp only [
    Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, mul_sub, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, sub_mul]
        _ = crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ [φ, ψ] ++ φs) •
            (ι (ofCrAnListF (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬crAnTimeOrderRel φ c)
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs)))) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs')) *
              ι [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧
                crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)) φs)) *
              ι (ofCrAnListF (List.filter (fun c => (crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬crAnTimeOrderRel c φ))
                (List.insertionSort crAnTimeOrderRel (φs' ++ φs))))) := by
            congr
            rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
              ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
            simp only [← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, map_sub, map_smul]
      rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ)]
      repeat rw [mul_assoc]
      rw [← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← map_mul, ← ofCrAnListF_append, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append]
      have h1 := insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' φs
      simp only [ List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append] at h1 ⊢
      rw [← h1, ← crAnTimeOrderList]
      by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) ≠ (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
      · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ (by grind only),
          ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF]
        simp only [map_smul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm]

    · simp only [pa, mul_zero, zero_mul, map_mul, map_zero]
    · intro x y _ _ hpx hpy
      simp only [pa, add_mul, mul_add, map_add, hpx, hpy]
    · intro c x _ hx
      simp only [pa, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hx]
  · simp only [pb, mul_zero, zero_mul, map_mul, map_zero]
  · intro x y _ _ hpx hpy
    simp only [pb, add_mul, mul_add, map_add, hpx, hpy]
  · intro c x _ hx
    simp only [pb, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, hx]

name: Cslib.LambdaCalculus.LocallyNameless.Fsub.Typing.progress
proof:
lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  have d2 := der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var h => cases h
  case app l r i1 i2 =>
    right
    obtain v|⟨_, h⟩ := i1 rfl l
    · obtain w|⟨_, h2⟩ := i2 rfl r
      · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := l.canonical_form_abs v
        exact ⟨_, .abs v.lc w⟩
      · exact ⟨_, .appᵣ v h2⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .appₗ r.wf.2.1 h⟩
  case tapp _ d s i =>
    right
    obtain v|⟨_, h⟩ := i rfl d
    · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_tabs v
      exact ⟨_, .tabs v.lc s.wf.2.1.lc⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .tapp s.wf.2.1.lc h⟩
  case let' d _ i _ =>
    right
    obtain v|⟨_, h⟩ := i rfl d
    · exact ⟨_, .let_body v (body_let.mp d2.wf.2.1).2⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .let_bind h (body_let.mp d2.wf.2.1).2⟩
  case inl d _ i => exact (i rfl d).imp .inl fun ⟨_, h⟩ => ⟨_, .inl h⟩
  case inr d _ i => exact (i rfl d).imp .inr fun ⟨_, h⟩ => ⟨_, .inr h⟩
  case case d _ _ i _ _ =>
    right
    obtain ⟨_, b2, b3⟩ := body_case.mp d2.wf.2.1
    obtain v|⟨_, h⟩ := i rfl d
    · obtain ⟨u, rfl|rfl⟩ := d.canonical_form_sum v
      · cases v with | inl w => exact ⟨_, .case_inl w b2 b3⟩
      · cases v with | inr w => exact ⟨_, .case_inr w b2 b3⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .case h b2 b3⟩
  case sub | abs | tabs => grind

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a b c h₁ h₂
  cases h₁
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · next ha hb => exact ⟨_, hb, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · next ha hb =>
        obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, hu, .red_K ..⟩
  · cases h₂
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S ..⟩
    · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    · next ha hb =>
        obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, .par (.par hu hb) (.par hv hb), .red_S ..⟩
  · next ha hb =>
      cases h₂
      · exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
      · exact ⟨_, I_irreducible _ ha ▸ .red_I _, hb⟩
      · obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hu⟩
      · obtain ⟨u, v, hu, hv, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
        exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hu hb) (.par hv hb)⟩
      · next ha' hb' =>
          obtain ⟨_, x, y⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond ha ha'
          obtain ⟨_, u, v⟩ := parallelReduction_diamond hb hb'
          exact ⟨_, .par x u, .par y v⟩

name: Cslib.CCS.bisimilarity_congr_choice
proof:
theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨ChoiceBisim, .choice h, ?_⟩
  intro _ _ hr _
  cases hr with
  | bisim => grind [ChoiceBisim, Bisimilarity.follow_fst, Bisimilarity.follow_snd]
  | choice hb =>
    constructor <;> intro x htr <;> cases htr with
      | choiceR h => exact ⟨_, .choiceR h, .bisim (.refl _)⟩
      | choiceL h => first
        | exact (hb.follow_fst h).imp fun _ ⟨hy, hr'⟩ => ⟨.choiceL hy, .bisim hr'⟩
        | exact (hb.follow_snd h).imp fun _ ⟨hy, hr'⟩ => ⟨.choiceL hy, .bisim hr'⟩

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  unfold fiberwiseClose at h_fw_dist_lt
  unfold hammingClose
  let C_i := BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_fw := fiberwiseDistance 𝔽q β (i := i) steps h_i_add_steps f
  let d_i := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i, by omega⟩
  let d_is := BBF_CodeDistance ℓ 𝓡 ⟨i.val + steps, by omega⟩
  have hpos : 0 < d_i := Nat.succ_pos _
  have hsb : ∀ a : ℕ, ↑i + steps ≤ a → a - (↑i + steps) + steps = a - ↑i := by
    intro a ha
    rw [Nat.sub_add_eq_sub_sub_rev _ _ _ (Nat.le_add_left _ _) ha, Nat.add_sub_cancel]
  have halg : (d_is - 1) * 2 ^ steps = d_i - 1 := by
    dsimp only [d_is, d_i, BBF_CodeDistance, Nat.add_one_sub_one]
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, ← Nat.pow_add, ← Nat.pow_add,
      hsb _ (Nat.le_trans h_i_add_steps (Nat.le_add_right _ _)), hsb _ h_i_add_steps]
  obtain ⟨g', hg', hmin⟩ : ∃ g' ∈ C_i,
      d_fw = (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g').ncard := by
    have hne : Set.Nonempty ((fun (g : C_i) =>
        (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g).ncard) '' Set.univ) :=
      Set.image_nonempty.mpr Set.univ_nonempty
    rcases Nat.sInf_mem hne with ⟨w, _, hw⟩
    exact ⟨w, w.property, hw.symm⟩
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g'
  let dH := Δ₀(f, ↑C_i)
  have hcount : hammingDist f g' ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    let q := iteratedQuotientMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i steps h_i_add_steps
    let s := Finset.univ.filter (fun x => f x ≠ g' x)
    show s.card ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps
    rw [mul_comm]
    refine (Finset.card_le_mul_card_image (f := q) s (2 ^ steps) fun b _ => ?_).trans
      (Nat.mul_le_mul_left (2 ^ steps) ?_)
    · have hsub : s.filter (fun a => q a = b) ⊆
          (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin (2 ^ steps))).image fun k =>
            qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := steps)
              (h_i_add_steps := fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) (y := b) k := by
        intro x hx
        exact Finset.mem_image.mpr ⟨pointToIterateQuotientIndex (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩)
            (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (x := x), Finset.mem_univ _,
          (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps (x := x) (y := b)).mp
            (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2.symm⟩
      exact Nat.le_trans (Finset.card_le_card hsub)
        (Finset.card_image_le.trans (by rw [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]))
    · rw [← Set.ncard_coe_finset]
      refine Set.ncard_le_ncard ?_
      intro y hy
      obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
      exact ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩
  have hbridge : dH ≤ ↑(d_fw * 2 ^ steps) := by
    refine le_trans (Code.distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g' hg') ?_
    rw [hmin]
    exact ENat.coe_le_coe.mpr hcount
  have hnat : 2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps) ≤ d_i - 1 := by
    rw [← Nat.mul_assoc, ← halg]
    exact Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ (Nat.le_of_lt_succ (WithTop.coe_lt_coe.1 h_fw_dist_lt))
  have h2 : (2 : ℕ∞) * dH ≤ ↑(2 * (d_fw * 2 ^ steps)) :=
    (mul_le_mul_left' hbridge 2).trans ((ENat.coe_mul _ _).symm).le
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt h2 (ENat.coe_lt_coe.mpr (Nat.lt_of_le_pred hpos hnat))

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fm := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (steps := 1) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_succ_lt) (y := y)
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have hq : ∀ k : Fin 2, (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fm k).val = y := by
    intro k
    exact congr_arg Subtype.val ((generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 (by omega)
      (fm k) y ⟨k, rfl⟩).trans (iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fm k))).symm
  have hd : (fm 1).val = (fm 0).val + 1 := by
    have h := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y
    have h0 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 := rfl
    have h1 : Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 := rfl
    dsimp only at h
    simp only [fm, h, h0, h1, Submodule.coe_add, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1 𝔽q β,
      zero_smul, one_smul, zero_add]
    exact add_comm _ _
  have hfold : f_i_plus_1 y
      = P_i.eval (fm 0).val * ((1 - r_chal) * (fm 1).val - r_chal)
        + P_i.eval (fm 1).val * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * (fm 0).val) := rfl
  have hpoly : P_i_plus_1 = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement, intermediateEvaluationPoly,
      Polynomial.C_add, Polynomial.C_mul, add_mul, mul_assoc, mul_sum, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact rfl
  rw [hfold, hpoly]
  simp only [P_i, P₀, P₁, evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs,
    Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C, hq]
  rw [hd]
  ring

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
    classical
    intro ϑ
    induction ϑ with
    | zero =>
      intro u
      contradiction
    | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
      cases ϑ_sub_1 with
      | zero =>
        simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
        intro u hprob_gt
        simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u),
          prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
            (P := fun r => distFromCode (affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r) MC ≤ e),
          Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hprob_gt
        have h_u_eq : u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) := by
          funext rowIdx
          match rowIdx with
          | 0 => rfl
          | 1 => rfl
        rw [h_u_eq]
        exact hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hprob_gt
      | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
        intro _ u hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        let ϑ_pred := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
        let U₀ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).1
        let U₁ := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ_pred) u).2
        have h_rec (r : Fin (ϑ_pred + 1) → F) : multilinearCombine u r =
            multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ (r (Fin.last ϑ_pred)))
              (fun i => r i.castSucc) := by
          rw [multilinearCombine_recursive_form]
          rfl
        simp_rw [h_rec] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        let hP_split_r_last := prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun (ϑ := ϑ_pred)
          (F := F) (P := fun r_last r_init =>
            distFromCode (multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r_last) r_init) MC ≤ e)
        rw [hP_split_r_last] at hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt
        let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m:=ϑ_pred) (e:=e) (ε:=ε) U₀ U₁
        let h_line_close := correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor
          (ih := fun u_prev => ih (by omega) u_prev) (u := u)
        apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
        apply h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ ϑ_pred) Nat.one_le_two_pow
        exact lt_of_le_of_lt'
          (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies _ (fun r => r ∈ R_star_set) _ fun r hr => h_line_close ⟨r, hr⟩)
          (prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ε := ε) (ϑ := ϑ_pred) (u := u) (e := e)
            hP_multilinearCombine_close_gt)

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f := fun n => (u n, u (n + 1), u (n + 2), u (n + 3))
  have hfin : Set.Finite (range f) :=
    ((finite_Icc B T).prod ((finite_Icc B T).prod ((finite_Icc B T).prod (finite_Icc B T)))).subset
      (range_subset_iff.mpr fun n => ⟨hB n, hB (n + 1), hB (n + 2), hB (n + 3)⟩)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h⟩ : ∃ i j : ℕ, i < j ∧ f i = f j := by
    by_contra! hc
    exact (not_infinite.mpr hfin) (infinite_range_of_injective fun a b hab => (Nat.lt_trichotomy a b).elim
      (fun hh => (hc a b hh hab).elim) fun hh => hh.elim id fun hh' => (hc b a hh' hab.symm).elim)
  obtain ⟨c, rfl, hc⟩ : ∃ c, j = i + c ∧ 0 < c := ⟨j - i, by omega, by omega⟩
  have hf (n : ℕ) : (u (n + 4) : ℝ) = (u (n + 3) + u (n + 2) + u (n + 1) * u n) / (u (n + 3) * u (n + 2) + u (n + 1) + u n) :=
    (hu (n + 4) (Nat.le_add_left 4 n)).1
  have H : ∀ k : ℕ, f (i + k) = f (i + c + k) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero => exact h
    | succ k ih =>
      simp only [f, Prod.mk.injEq] at ih ⊢
      have e : (u (i + k + 4) : ℝ) = (u (i + c + k + 4) : ℝ) := by rw [hf, hf, ih.1, ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2]
      exact ⟨ih.2.1, ih.2.2.1, ih.2.2.2, Int.cast_inj.1 e⟩
  refine ⟨i, c, hc, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  convert (congrArg Prod.fst (H (n - i))).symm using 2 <;> omega

name: putnam_1964_b2
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have h2 := (Set.Intersecting.is_max_iff_card_eq fun a ha b hb =>
      hPP a ha b hb ∘ Disjoint.inter_eq).mp fun t ht hP =>
      hP.antisymm fun x hx => Classical.byContradiction
        (hPS ⟨x, ·, fun U hU => ht hx (hP hU) ∘ Set.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty.mpr⟩)
  rw [Fintype.card_set, ← pow_sub_one_mul Fintype.card_ne_zero] at h2
  omega

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩
  have hde := ((hrelation d e).mp hde).2
  have hef := ((hrelation e f).mp hef).2
  let w : Fin 9 → ℤ := fun i => 10 ^ i.1
  have hN : ∀ x, digits_to_num x = ∑ i, x i * w i := congrFun hdigits_to_num
  have upd (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j => if j = i then y j else x j) = digits_to_num x + (y i * w i - x i * w i) := by
    rw [hN, hN, ← Fintype.sum_ite_eq' i fun j => y j * w j - x j * w j, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => by by_cases h : j = i <;> simp [h]
  have hd := fun i => (upd d e i) ▸ hde i
  have he := fun i => (upd e f i) ▸ hef i
  have hDE : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    refine (Int.dvd_self_mul_add (b := digits_to_num d)).mp ?_
    convert Finset.dvd_sum fun i _ => hd i using 1
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, ← hN, ← hN, Finset.sum_const,
      Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin]
    ring
  have hu : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) (10 : ℤ) := by norm_num
  intro i

  refine (hu.pow_right (n := i)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right ?_
  convert dvd_sub (dvd_sub hDE (hd i)) (he i) using 1
  ring
